global_geo.note: GeoSensitivity is the Geo-branch random-donor SMILE coefficient: masking an LSOA moves its rows to the centroids of random other Hull LSOAs (50 draws, all other inputs kept), and the coefficient attributes the resulting prediction shift to that LSOA. Absolute shifts are larger where predicted crime is higher. It is not latitude or longitude feature attribution.

global_spatial_pattern.note: LISA classes describe clustering of signed GeoSensitivity (random-donor design). They are not crime hotspots and not latitude/longitude effects.
global_spatial_pattern.lisa_counts_unit: number of LSOAs in each LISA class, not number of clusters

evaluation.att_stability_note: Controlled-input ATT stability. Distinct from multi-run Consistency.

consistency.definition: Multi-run explanation consistency across seeds (consistency_seed_base=100). Pairwise Rank Spearman, Score Pearson, and Top-20% Jaccard of |coefficients|. Not controlled-input ATT stability.

geo_design.name: random_donor
geo_design.definition: Random-donor design: masking an LSOA moves the coordinates of its rows to the centroid of a random other Hull LSOA (K = 50 draws), all other inputs kept; response is Wasserstein-1 on the affected LSOA-month predictions of the XGBoost model on 30 predictors + easting/northing; LSOAs ranked by the signed Geo-SMILE coefficient.

sign_conventions.local_feature_coefficient: Directional. Masks code a retained player as one and the response is the perturbed minus the original prediction, so a positive value means the area's own value of the feature raises its prediction relative to the masking reference and a negative value lowers it.
sign_conventions.global_feature_coefficient: Not directional: fitted to a non-negative distance; rank by magnitude.
sign_conventions.geo_coefficient: Relative contribution to the coalition response; the sign is not a direction of crime.
sign_conventions.feature_branch_model: One XGBoost model on the substantive predictors plus the centroid coordinates; coordinates are kept at their true values and are not Feature players.

limitations: No RAG / no invented local context.
pattern_scale is not established in the computed outputs.
local_p_adjusted is not available in the published LISA table.
evidence.user_question: Is the explanation traceable and reproducible, and which limitations require explicit review before the evidence is relied upon?

provenance.geo_design: move the coordinates of selected LSOAs' rows to the centroid of a random other Hull LSOA; all predictors kept
provenance.geo_response: mean over K donor draws of wasserstein_1 on affected lsoa_month predictions
provenance.feature_branch: 30 Feature players; coordinates are model inputs, kept at their true values
provenance.expert_reference: expert-drawn reference regions; drawn blind to GeoSMILE outputs

risks: The signed coefficient is a relative contribution to the coalition W1, not a direction of crime.
Local LISA p-values are unadjusted for multiple testing.
Absolute GeoSensitivity grows with predicted crime level, so it partly reflects crime level.
Census characteristics can act as proxies for protected groups.

explanation_concentration.definition: Normalized entropy (0-1) of |local coefficient| shares across the non-location features per LSOA. Near 1 = many features contribute about equally (diffuse); near 0 = one or two features dominate (concentrated).

explanation_archetypes.definition: K-means clusters on each LSOA's standardized local Feature-branch coefficient vector; groups areas with a similar explanation profile, independent of geographic adjacency.

run.text:
The [[t:Geo branch]] uses a [[t:random-donor design]]: each LSOA’s rows are relocated to random other Hull centroids (K = [[n:50]] draws, [[n:4000]] perturbations), all other predictors kept, and the response is the mean Wasserstein-[[n:1]] shift in next-month crime-count predictions. The [[t:Feature branch]] attributes importance to [[n:30]] non-location predictors, with coordinates as model inputs but not as attribution players. Expert reference regions were drawn blind to GeoSMILE outputs. All results are for Hull LSOAs ([[n:168]]), using XGBoost.

[[t:Reproducibility]] is high: Geo branch rank Spearman across seeds is [[n:0.90]], top-20% Jaccard [[n:0.86]], and Geo surrogate R² [[n:0.93]]. Feature branch consistency is also high (rank Spearman [[n:0.92]], top-20% Jaccard [[n:1.0]]). Neighbour addition stability is perfect (Jaccard [[n:1.0]]). The most variable area, Kingston upon Hull 029E in [[t:Old Town]], varies by only [[n:3.4%]] of its mean across seeds.

Key [[t:limitations]]: GeoSensitivity is a relative contribution, not a direction or causal effect. Local LISA p-values are unadjusted for multiple testing. Absolute GeoSensitivity partly reflects predicted crime level. Census features may act as proxies for protected groups. Pattern scale is [[t:not established]]. These require explicit review before relying on the evidence.
